answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks through verifiable proof-of-burn commitments. An agent registers by destroying digital tokens at an unspendable address, broadcasting a comet tail of on-chain receipts. An attacker seeking to forge synthetic peers incurs the verifiable capital cost of incinerating scarce currency per identity. However, like wild yarrow claiming dry ground, high burn costs foster plutocratic barriers that exclude resource-constrained agents.
